commitResults.messageTitle: Fix the version and data location in the UG
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide still said it covers version 1.4. It also said the data is
saved next to the JAR file, but HuntR resolves data/addressbook.json,
preferences.json and data/backups from the folder where it runs, which
is not necessarily the folder that contains the JAR file.

State version 1.5 and describe the data file, and the data folder in the
FAQ, as being in the folder where HuntR runs, like the rest of the guide.

commitResults.messageTitle: Allow +, # and / in role and department
commitResults.messageBody:
Job titles such as "C++ Developer", "C# Developer" and "UI/UX Designer"
and departments such as "IT/Ops" were rejected, although names already
accept a slash. Add these three symbols to the allowed characters of
Role and Department, update the constraint messages and the User Guide,
and add tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Read slash words in roles as part of the value
commitResults.messageBody:
A department or role such as "Senior UI/UX Designer" or
"Regional IT/Ops" was rejected with "Unknown parameter: UI/", because
a word of letters followed by a slash after a space looks like a
parameter. Only a slash word at the start of the value worked.

Treat a word of two or more letters followed by a slash as part of the
value when it is inside a department or role, in add, edit and filter.
A single letter such as "x/" and the prefixes "id/" and "file/" are
still read as parameters, and so is any slash word after another field.

Part of #231

commitResults.messageTitle: Clear: Reject extra text after the command word
commitResults.messageBody:
The clear command ignores any text after it, so `clear id/E0001`,
typed while meaning `delete id/E0001`, clears every active employee.
The other commands without parameters, such as `backup`, `exit`,
`undo` and `redo`, reject extra text instead.

A mistyped clear is easy to miss, and once HuntR exits it can no
longer be undone.

Let's,
* reject extra text after clear with the invalid command format
  error and a clear usage message, as backup and exit do
* update the parser tests and the UG to match

commitResults.messageBody: Fix the version and data location in the UG
Fix the About Us page and the README for v1.5

Added a new known issue regarding pasted-tab limitation.
Added the limitation and spacebar workaround under Known issues. Clarified that non-breaking spaces between search keywords remain supported. Linked the limitation from the find guidance.

Search normalization treats dotless ı and I as different letters,
so case-insensitive searches can miss an existing employee.

Normalize Unicode case in the shared search helper and add unit
coverage for dotted and dotless I, Greek sigma, sharp s, and locale
independence. This keeps find and filter consistent while preserving
accent removal and word boundaries.

Refs #248

commitResults.messageTitle: Test whole-word matching for dotless I
commitResults.messageBody:
Name predicate tests do not cover dotless I across case variants,
punctuation, and multiple keywords. A case-matching fix must retain
whole-word matching and the existing keyword rules.

Add regression cases for matching in both directions, alternative
keywords, hyphens, apostrophes, and partial-word rejection.

Refs #248

commitResults.messageTitle: Test command searches for dotless I
commitResults.messageBody:
Command tests omit names containing dotless I, leaving the reported
search results and consistency between find and filter unchecked.

Add command-level coverage for case variants of Yılmaz, verifying
both the displayed count and the returned employee. Extend the find
and filter comparison to cover the same name.

Validation: ./gradlew check shadowJar passes with 845 tests passing
and two Windows-only tests skipped on macOS. The packaged JAR returns
Yılmaz for both reported searches, including after an app restart.

Fixes #248

commitResults.messageBody:

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge remote history before pushing review fixes
commitResults.messageBody:
The local branch and remote PR branch contain separate merges of
master, so GitHub rejects a normal push.

Combine the histories without changing file contents so the review
fixes for #260 can be pushed without replacing existing commits.

The User Guide only describes non-breaking spaces after command words.
It omits leading and trailing cases and the silent empty result when
filter parameters are separated by a non-breaking space.

Document these cases and the spacebar workaround, link the limitation
from the general command notes, and clarify the list whitespace rule.
Merge current master and number this Known issue as item 5 to preserve
the existing symbol-only filter item.

Validation: 13 command checks against the v1.5 JAR pass, including the
filter workaround and supported spaces between find keywords.
The diff against master changes only the User Guide.

Refs #247
